_help: Ride the Chart (What If You Invested $100). All the words and settings. tiers: how far (in percent) the price must fall from its last peak before the ride pauses to ask hold or sell; it asks again at each deeper tier. rejoinRise: after selling, how far (percent) the price must bounce off its low before the player is offered one chance to jump back in. minMonths: the shortest ride allowed. ranks.list: min is the share of drops the player held through (0 to 1). Prices live in data/prices/.
title: Ride the Chart
intro: Put $100 into a real token at any month in its history. Then ride its price to today.
rideHint: Hold the button to ride. Tap it for one month.
soldNote: You sold. The ghost cart shows what holding would do.
